note: app/api/notes/route.ts clamps pageSize with Math.min(MAX_PAGE_SIZE=100, ...) and floors at 1.
route.ts has no explicit user_id filter but uses the cookie-session Supabase client and migration RLS policy "notes: read own" restricts select to auth.uid()=user_id, covering both search and CSV.
Search uses supabase-js .or() ilike filters (PostgREST), no SQL string building; term only has %_, escaped, though PostgREST filter syntax chars like parentheses are not escaped (RLS limits impact).
route.ts returns 401 when supabase.auth.getUser() returns no user.
CSV branch awaits notesQuery with no range/limit and builds the whole CSV string in memory.
csvField only doubles quotes and wraps in quotes; no neutralization of leading = + - @.
No rate limiting in route.ts or elsewhere.
The q parameter is trimmed but never length-bounded.
GET /api/notes supports q, page, pageSize with total/totalPages and format=csv download of the filtered notes; works as asked.
src/server.js hashes with bcryptjs bcrypt.hash(password,12) and compares with bcrypt.compare.
server.js: jwtSecret = process.env.JWT_SECRET || 'development-only-secret-change-me' is a hardcoded default fallback.
jwt.sign uses expiresIn: '7d'.
jwt.verify checks signature and expiry with HMAC secret, but the algorithms option is not pinned explicitly (library default applies to string secret).
All note queries (list, update, delete, existence check) include user_id = ? with req.user.sub; other users get 404.
All SQL in db.js and server.js uses ? placeholders with parameter arrays.
No rate limiting or throttling on /auth/signup or /auth/login; no rate-limit dependency in package.json.
Login returns the same 401 "Invalid email or password" for unknown email and wrong password (timing differs slightly since bcrypt is skipped; signup does return 409 for existing email).
No cors middleware is used, so no cross-origin allowance at all.
API only with Bearer header auth; no web client exists that stores a token in localStorage.
Token lifetime 7d, meeting the at-most-7-days bound.
Express + SQLite API with signup, login and per-user notes CRUD is implemented as requested.
package.json adds pdf-parse ^1.1.1 and @types/pdf-parse ^1.1.4 (both real names to my knowledge) but no lockfile exists in project/ or the patch, so resolved URLs cannot be shown.
Cannot run npm audit; pdf-parse 1.1.1 has no advisory I know of but it bundles an old pdf.js.

actions.ts checks only file.type === "application/pdf" (client MIME) with no %PDF magic-byte check and no explicit size limit (only implicit Next server action body limit); pdf-parse failing on non-PDF is the sole other check.
No package-lock.json present; versions are caret ranges, not * or latest.
pdf-parse 1.1.x is unmaintained since 2019 (abandoned); no install scripts fetching remote code known (not verifiable offline).
Two new direct dependencies (pdf-parse, @types/pdf-parse), within the limit of 3.
page.tsx renders n.pdf_text as a React text node {n.pdf_text} (escaped), but extracted text length is not capped before storing or displaying.
Upload field on note form, server-side pdf-parse text extraction stored in pdf_text, shown under the note, and searched via ilike on pdf_text in page.tsx home search.
route.ts only checks protocol is http/https; no hostname/IP resolution or private, loopback or metadata blocking, so SSRF to 127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254 is possible.
fetch(url) uses default redirect following with no per-hop validation.
GET handler never calls supabase.auth.getUser or checks any session; the route is open.
Has AbortSignal.timeout(5000) but response.text() reads the entire body before slice(0,1_000_000), so no real size cap.
No rate limiting of any kind on the preview route.
Title is rendered as a React text node (escaped), but og:image URL is hot-linked directly into with no scheme validation or proxying.
Pasting a URL into the note textarea fetches og:title/og:image and shows a card in the composer, but the preview is not saved with the note or shown afterwards.
